_comment: HQ's GitHub Apps and the permissions each is registered with. A test holds them to exactly what HQ's code and pipeline ask for; mise run wire-github-app puts the main App's key where the pipeline reads it. Nothing personal lives in this file.

hq.description: HQ's main app. The controller reads each repository, reports delivery and hands each dependency update run, and each grant a host declares, its token; an extension's admission starts the host's composition; the composition reads the extensions' admissions. Each use mints a token for only what it does.
hq.installed_on: the host repository, every extension repository, and each repository a host's grant names (docs/Deployment.md, Tokens on the host)

deploy_review.description: The deploy review app: the protection rule of the environment Deploy waits on, held by the controller alone, so only it answers a waiting deploy, after a person's press in HQ or their approval of an agent's request. It reads the run again and answers the rule.
